def choose_move(observation):
    agent = observation.get('agent', {})
    x, y = agent.get('position', (0, 0))

    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    # Combine all targets into one list if they exist
    targets = resources or enemies or border

    if targets:
        # Find closest target
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - x) + abs(t[1] - y))
        dx = (target[0] - x)
        dy = (target[1] - y)
        # Normalize to -1, 0, or 1
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Default move (stay close to origin or random)
        return [0, 0]
